properties.statement: Step 2's last trial: the re-read of the stage-5 design (flo2.io 7aa8a90d21c8956c, outside the hub) on reflow2 0.88.0. Chris has not answered his six round-1 questions; Anthony answered them provisionally as six accepted working assumptions (dec:assume-* there), and the argument was restructured on them (chg:argument-restructured-on-six-working-assumptions-2026-10-19 there). READ 1 (premises proposed): 34 → 39 claims, roots 6 → 7, Premise 2 now in rests_on (it supported nothing before), still_contested 6 → 8; every claim read unknown, so no what-if could show a line surviving. Rejecting Premise 2 removes only the harm claim, Premise 6 only the modernity-bias check (both as intended). READ 2, on Anthony's 'run the re-read again', after the nine premises were marked taken_as_given (chg:the-nine-premises-are-taken-as-given-2026-10-19 there): stated_foundations 0 → 9, uncited premises 1 → 0, unsupported 1 → 0; claims 15: shown 2 (untrained affections; the modernity-bias check), unproven 13, contested 0, objections standing 8. A what-if on Premise 5 now shows a real loss (untrained affections: holds → unsupported). GAPS: (1) EVIDENCE: the ev-* records summarise sources from the pinned analysis and read unknown; 'cited' applies only to theorem/lemma/corollary statements, so empirical evidence has no honest way to count, and every claim resting on it stays unproven (phase 6, req:evidence-carries-its-source-grade-and-confidence-and-is-not-intent). (2) A CONTESTED FOUNDATION: Premises 8 and 9 are taken as given and each has a standing objection, so they read unknown and what rests on them reads plain 'unproven', indistinguishable from a claim nothing supports; the tally counts 0 contested claims while 8 objections stand. (3) RADIUS: every what-if reports total_impacted 66 and the same nine risk_crossings, because the walk climbs DECOMPOSES to the deliverable and fans out; and `still_supported_by` is empty for claim (b1) under Premise 5 although its encounter line does not use Premise 5 (that line is itself unknown, so it cannot count). (4) the flo2 connector's describe of review_relations lists `links` as an array with no item fields (field limitation 24, on the hosted door).
